summary: Stat tile with a rolling value, a change chip against a previous value and a pixel history; invert makes a drop read as good.

props.name: value
props.description: The metric. Changes roll in, upward when the value grows.

props.name: previous
props.description: Comparison value. When set and not 0, a chip shows the percentage change with ▲ or ▼.

props.name: invert
props.description: For metrics where lower is better: a drop is coloured green and a rise red.

props.name: format
props.description: `percent` shows one decimal and %, `compact` shortens large numbers (48.2K). Uses en-US formatting.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency code used with `format="currency"`. Amounts from 1,000 up show whole units.

props.name: note
props.description: Muted text at the end of the value row, such as "vs. last month".

props.name: data
props.description: History drawn as pixel columns; needs at least two finite values (others are dropped). A change replays the draw-in.

accessibility: The value is an `aria-live="polite"` region, so updates are announced.
The history canvas is `aria-hidden`. The change chip shows ▲ or ▼ visually and reads as words, for example "Up 12.4%".
motion: With reduced motion the value and change chip swap without rolling and the history appears at once.
notes: The history has the colour of the change chip: green when the change is good, red when it is bad. Without a chip (no `previous`, or 0) it is green.
`percent` shows the value as given, so `12.5` reads 12.5%.
